title: Creating a Multimodal Dataset of Images and Text to Study Abusive Language
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It focuses on creating a multimodal dataset to study general abusive language and the triggers for offensive comments related to images, with categories like 'Body', 'Clothing', and 'Pose'.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. The analysis focuses on the correlation between the subject of a picture (e.g., male, female, no person) and the likelihood of receiving an offensive comment, as well as the non-religious trigger categories for such comments.
